captions.instagram:
AI is invited in. It doesn't own the house.

In rotli you decide, note by note, what AI may see:
• Mark a note secure and no remote model ever sees it, not even the title.
• Lock a note and every model can read it, but none can edit it.
• On-device models run on your Mac with no network.

Secure is an AI access rule, not encryption: the note stays a plain file protected by your Mac account and FileVault.

The full policy, in plain language: rotli.co/privacy

captions.linkedin:
How should a notes app handle AI? Our answer in rotli: per note, and enforced by the app rather than left to the model.

• Secure: never sent to a remote model, not even the title. On-device models can still read it unless you turn that off.
• Locked: every model may read it; no model may edit it.

Secure is an AI access rule, not encryption; the note is still a plain file protected by your Mac account and FileVault. We wrote the full policy in plain language, with the reason behind each rule: rotli.co/privacy
